semantic_constraints.series: a tourism series is keyed by dataset, indicator (nights spent, arrivals, establishments, bedrooms, bed places), residence of guest (c_resid), accommodation type (nace_r2), unit, frequency and geography with its NUTS version; monthly national and annual NUTS 2 series are always different series and an annual total is never computed from months; values live in the Economics series storage (economic_vintages, dataset_observations)
semantic_constraints.vintages: each release that changes a series is an appended vintage with release (Eurostat LAST UPDATE) and retrieval clocks, revision_of and the recorded changes; a provisional month revised later is a new vintage, never an overwrite; a series a complete later release no longer states gets a removed_by_source vintage; as-of answers select the vintage released by the date and cite source, record revision and as-of time
semantic_constraints.flags: Eurostat OBS_FLAG letters are kept verbatim per value; a confidential cell (c) is a status and carries no value; the capacity reference date Eurostat states is stored per value
semantic_constraints.definitions: each series cites its definition revision, including the establishment-size threshold each country applies as a definition note; a changed definition is a new revision
semantic_constraints.comparability: history pairs list source-stated breaks (b), definition differences (d), threshold changes, provisional months revised and NUTS version changes through the published correspondence; a pair without notes is comparability_unknown; nothing is blended
semantic_constraints.identity: countries and NUTS regions match Geospatial places only through reviewed published codes, code before name; a NUTS code-list change is a different place key, linked only through Eurostat's published correspondence as a reviewable link; nothing is auto-merged and unmatched keys stay visible
semantic_constraints.links: links to Geospatial boundary features (shared NUTS code in the series' NUTS version) and to economics.labour series for NACE Rev.2 section I (shared code or accepted place matches) record their basis and pin both revisions; never a ratio; absent providers and targets are reported as provider_absent or target_not_held, never dropped
semantic_constraints.sources: Eurostat tourism occupancy and capacity are unverified-live until a dated live run; UN Tourism statistics are not-implemented and reported as such, never as an empty answer
semantic_constraints.minimisation: published aggregates only; traveller survey microdata (tour_dem_*), establishment-level returns and experimental platform data (tour_ce_oa*) are never acquired; person-, guest- and establishment-level fields are refused at write time
semantic_constraints.exclusions: no nowcasting, no filled months or regions, no seasonal adjustment of our own, no blending of Eurostat and UN Tourism figures, no occupancy rates, averages, per-capita or per-bed figures of our own, no derived indicators, no forecasts
